# Hi - I'm Louis De Neve

Graduate student at the University of Oxford, working with AI for the environment for my Intelligent Earth DPhil. </br>
I hold a MSci in Quantitative Climate and Environmental Sciences and  BA in Natural Sciences from the University of Cambridge. </br>
Outside of research, I like travelling with a camera and spend a lot of time in rowing boats.
